knowledge.text: 最壞延遲5+10+2=17分鐘；同步等待縮為3分鐘後為10分鐘。

options: 用同一externalId重播兩次停用事件，應維持同一使用者且不產生重複資源；逐系統確認active狀態與群組殘留。
離職後仍可操作可能是應用尚未套用active=false，或舊session不受身分停用自動撤銷。

optionsEn: Replay a disable event twice for the same externalId; retain one user without duplicate resources and inspect active status and residual groups in each system.
Continued access after departure may reflect an unapplied active=false or an old session that is not automatically revoked on account disable.
Detection waits at most 5 minutes, sync waits 10 and target application takes 2; assume serial stages without retries.

Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each. steps.instruction:
交付去識別化身分關聯表、冪等測試與端到端停權時間線。
在交接件中加入「SCIM：資產、信任邊界與測試資料」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：建立虛構HR、IdP與兩個應用程式的身分關聯表；區分停用、刪除、移除群組與撤銷既有工作階段，定義每一步成功證據。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立虛構HR、IdP與兩個應用程式的身分關聯表；區分停用、刪除、移除群組與撤銷既有工作階段，定義每一步成功證據。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver pseudonymous identity mappings, idempotency tests and an end-to-end deprovisioning timeline.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for SCIM：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。建立虛構HR、IdP與兩個應用程式的身分關聯表；區分停用、刪除、移除群組與撤銷既有工作階段，定義每一步成功證據。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: SCIM以標準化HTTP協定管理跨系統的使用者與群組資源。
knowledge.textEn: SCIM standardizes HTTP-based management of user and group resources across systems.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立虛構HR、IdP與兩個應用程式的身分關聯表；區分停用、刪除、移除群組與撤銷既有工作階段，定義每一步成功證據。
knowledge.textEn: Map fictional HR, IdP and two application identities; distinguish disabling, deletion, group removal and existing-session revocation, with evidence for each.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 串行最壞停權延遲=來源偵測等待+同步排程等待+目標套用時間；這是所設教學流程的上限，不是SCIM協定保證。
knowledge.textEn: Serial worst-case deprovisioning delay is source detection wait plus sync wait plus target application time; it bounds this teaching workflow, not SCIM itself.
